quranTranslation.text: Allah is He Who sendeth the winds so that they raise clouds, and spreadeth them along the sky as pleaseth Him, and causeth them to break and thou seest the rain downpouring from within them. And when He maketh it to fall on whom He will of His bondmen, lo! they rejoice;

explanation.bs: Allah šalje vjetrove koji pokreću oblake – slanje potčinjenih stvari.
explanation.en: Allah sends the winds which stir up clouds — the sending of things made subject.

quranTranslation.text: Lo! We sent Noah unto his people (saying): Warn thy people ere the painful doom come unto them.

explanation.bs: „Mi smo Nuha poslali njegovom narodu“ – slanje poslanika.
explanation.en: “We sent Noah unto his people” — the sending of a messenger.

quranTranslation.text: And send against them swarms of flying creatures,

explanation.bs: Na vlasnike slona poslao je jata ptica – slanje kao kazna.
explanation.en: He sent against the people of the elephant birds in flocks — sending as punishment.

quranTranslation.text: He it is Who hath sent among the unlettered ones a messenger of their own, to recite unto them His revelations and to make them grow, and to teach them the Scripture and wisdom, though heretofore they were indeed in error manifest,

explanation.bs: On je nepismenima poslao Poslanika iz njihove sredine – poslanik podignut iz naroda i upućen njemu.
explanation.en: He it is who sent among the unlettered a Messenger from themselves — a messenger raised up from a people and sent to them.

quranTranslation.text: Then We revived you after your extinction, that ye might give thanks.

explanation.bs: „Zatim smo vas nakon vaše smrti oživjeli“ – بَعَثَ za vraćanje u život.
explanation.en: “Then We revived you after your extinction” — بَعَثَ for bringing back to life.

quranTranslation.text: And in like manner We awakened them that they might question one another. A speaker from among them said: How long have ye tarried? They said: We have tarried a day or some part of a day, (Others) said: Your Lord best knoweth what ye have tarried. Now send one of you with this your silver coin unto the city, and let him see what food is purest there and bring you a supply thereof. Let him be courteous and let no man know of you.

explanation.bs: „I isto tako smo ih probudili“ – stanovnici pećine podignuti iz dugog sna.
explanation.en: “And in like manner We awakened them” — the people of the cave raised from their long sleep.

quranTranslation.text: Who know that they will have to meet their Lord, and that unto Him they are returning.

explanation.bs: Oni koji znaju da će pred Gospodara svoga izaći – tefsir: ظَنَّ ovdje znači uvjerenje.
explanation.en: Those who are certain that they will meet their Lord — tafsir: ẓann here means certainty.

quranTranslation.text: And when it was said: Lo! Allah's promise is the truth, and there is no doubt of the Hour's coming, ye said: We know not what the Hour is. We deem it naught but a conjecture, and we are by no means convinced.

explanation.bs: „Mi samo pretpostavljamo, i nismo u to uvjereni“ – ظَنَّ kao slaba pretpostavka.
explanation.en: “We deem it naught but a conjecture, and we are by no means convinced” — ẓann as weak supposition.

quranTranslation.text: Do men imagine that they will be left (at ease) because they say, We believe, and will not be tested with affliction?

explanation.bs: „Zar ljudi misle da će ih se pustiti samo zato što kažu: ‚Vjerujemo‘, i da ih niko neće iskušati?“
explanation.en: “Do men imagine that they will be left (at ease) because they say, We believe, and will not be tested with affliction?”

quranTranslation.text: Those whose effort goeth astray in the life of the world, and yet they reckon that they do good work.

explanation.bs: Oni misle da dobro rade – pogrešno uvjerenje bez sumnje.
explanation.en: While they think that they are doing well in work — a mistaken belief without doubt.

quranTranslation.text: Think not of those, who are slain in the way of Allah, as dead. Nay, they are living. With their Lord they have provision.

explanation.bs: „I nikako ne misli da su mrtvi oni koji su ubijeni na Allahovom putu.“
explanation.en: “Think not of those, who are slain in the way of Allah, as dead.”

quranTranslation.text: Those who disbelieve assert that they will not be raised again. Say (unto them, O Muhammad): Yea, verily, by my Lord! ye will be raised again and then ye will be informed of what ye did; and that is easy for Allah.

explanation.bs: Nevjernici tvrde da neće biti oživljeni.
explanation.en: Those who disbelieve have claimed that they will never be resurrected.

quranTranslation.text: And on the day We gather them together We shall say unto those who ascribed partners (unto Allah): Where are (now) those partners of your make-believe?

explanation.bs: „Gdje su sada oni koje ste tvrdili da su vam ortaci?“
explanation.en: “Where are (now) those partners of your make-believe?”

quranTranslation.text: And (be mindful of) the Day when He will say: Call those partners of Mine whom ye pretended. Then they will cry unto them, but they will not hear their prayer, and We shall set a gulf of doom between them.

explanation.bs: „Zovite Moje ortake za koje ste tvrdili (da to jesu).“
explanation.en: “Call those partners of Mine whom ye pretended.”

quranTranslation.text: Who are humble in their prayers,

explanation.bs: „…koji su u svojim namazima skrušeni“ – skrušenost u ibadetu.
explanation.en: “Who are humble in their prayers” — humility in worship.

quranTranslation.text: If We had caused this Qur'an to descend upon a mountain, thou (O Muhammad) verily hadst seen it humbled, rent asunder by the fear of Allah. Such similitudes coin We for mankind that haply they may reflect.

explanation.bs: „…vidio bi je skrušenu, kako puca od straha pred Allahom“ – planina, kad bi joj bio objavljen Kur'an.
explanation.en: “Thou (O Muhammad) verily hadst seen it humbled, rent asunder by the fear of Allah” — a mountain, were the Quran sent down upon it.

quranTranslation.text: On that day (many) faces will be downcast,

explanation.bs: „Neka lica će toga dana biti oborena (خَاشِعَة)“ – skrušenost iz poniženja.
explanation.en: “On that day (many) faces will be downcast” (خَاشِعَة) — lowliness from abasement.

quranTranslation.text: (O mankind!) Call upon your Lord humbly and in secret. Lo! He loveth not aggressors.

explanation.bs: „Prizivajte svoga Gospodara ponizno (تَضَرُّعًا) i skriveno“ – kako se upućuje dova.
explanation.en: “Call upon your Lord humbly (تَضَرُّعًا) and in secret” — how supplication is made.

quranTranslation.text: Say: Who delivereth you from the darkness of the land and the sea? Ye call upon Him humbly and in secret, (saying): If we are delivered from this (fear) we truly will be of the thankful.

explanation.bs: „…prizivate Ga ponizno i skriveno“ – preklinjanje u nevolji na kopnu i moru.
explanation.en: “Ye call upon Him humbly and in secret” — entreaty in distress on land and sea.

quranTranslation.text: And do thou (O Muhammad) remember thy Lord within thyself humbly and with awe, below thy breath, at morn and evening. And be not thou of the neglectful.

explanation.bs: „I sjećaj se svoga Gospodara u duši svojoj, ponizno moleći i u strahu“ – تَضَرُّع i u zikru.
explanation.en: “Remember thy Lord within thyself humbly and with awe” — تَضَرُّع in remembrance too.

quranTranslation.text: If We will, We can send down on them from the sky a portent so that their necks would remain bowed before it.

explanation.bs: „…pa bi njihovi vratovi (ili: prvaci njihovi) pred njim ostali pokorno pognuti“ – pokornost na koju bi bili prisiljeni.
explanation.en: “…so that their necks (or: their leaders) would remain bowed before it” — a submission they would be forced into.

quranTranslation.text: Come not near the wealth of the orphan save with that which is better till he come to strength; and keep the covenant. Lo! of the covenant it will be asked.

explanation.bs: „I ispunjavajte zavjet (الْعَهْد), jer će se za zavjet zaista pitati.“
explanation.en: “And keep the covenant (الْعَهْد). Lo! of the covenant it will be asked.”

quranTranslation.text: Those who break the covenant of Allah after ratifying it, and sever that which Allah ordered to be joined, and (who) make mischief in the earth: Those are they who are the losers.

explanation.bs: „Oni koji krše Allahov zavjet (عَهْد) pošto su ga čvrsto potvrdili (مِيثَاق)“ – obje riječi zajedno.
explanation.en: “Those who break the covenant (عَهْد) of Allah after ratifying it (مِيثَاق)” — both words together.

quranTranslation.text: Lo! Allah hath bought from the believers their lives and their wealth because the Garden will be theirs: they shall fight in the way of Allah and shall slay and be slain. It is a promise which is binding on Him in the Torah and the Gospel and the Qur'an. Who fulfilleth His covenant better than Allah? Rejoice then in your bargain that ye have made, for that is the supreme triumph.

explanation.bs: „A ko svoj zavjet ispunjava bolje od Allaha?“
explanation.en: “Who fulfilleth His covenant better than Allah?”

quranTranslation.text: When Allah made (His) covenant with the prophets, (He said): Behold that which I have given you of the Scripture and knowledge. And afterward there will come unto you a messenger, confirming that which ye possess. Ye shall believe in him and ye shall help him. He said: Do ye agree, and will ye take up My burden (which I lay upon you) in this (matter)? They answered: We agree. He said: Then bear ye witness. I will be a witness with you.

explanation.bs: „I kad je Allah uzeo ugovor (مِيثَاق) od vjerovjesnika…“ – ugovor s vjerovjesnicima.
explanation.en: “When Allah made (His) covenant (مِيثَاق) with the prophets…” — the pact with the prophets.

quranTranslation.text: How can ye take it (back) after one of you hath gone in unto the other, and they have taken a strong pledge from you?

explanation.bs: „…a uzele su od vas čvrst ugovor (مِيثَاقًا غَلِيظًا)“ – brak kao čvrst ugovor.
explanation.en: “…and they have taken a strong pledge (مِيثَاقًا غَلِيظًا) from you” — marriage as a firm pact.

quranTranslation.text: Such as keep the pact of Allah, and break not the covenant;

explanation.bs: „Oni koji ispunjavaju zavjet dat Allahu i ne raskidaju ugovor“ – عَهْد i مِيثَاق jedno uz drugo.
explanation.en: “Such as keep the pact (عَهْد) of Allah, and break not the covenant (مِيثَاق)” — عَهْد and مِيثَاق side by side.

quranTranslation.text: Hast thou seen him who maketh his desire his god, and Allah sendeth him astray purposely, and sealeth up his hearing and his heart, and setteth on his sight a covering? Then who will lead him after Allah (hath condemned him)? Will ye not then heed?

explanation.bs: „Zar si vidio onoga koji je svoju strast uzeo za svoga boga?“ – ar-Rāġib navodi ovaj ajet.
explanation.en: “Hast thou seen him who maketh his desire his god” — ar-Rāġib cites this ayah.

quranTranslation.text: But as for him who feared to stand before his Lord and restrained his soul from lust,

explanation.bs: „A onaj ko se bojao stajanja pred svojim Gospodarom i dušu od strasti suzdržavao“ – ar-Rāġib: suzdržati dušu od njene požude.
explanation.en: “But as for him who feared to stand before his Lord and restrained his soul from lust” — ar-Rāġib: to hold the soul back from its shahwa.

quranTranslation.text: And if the Truth had followed their desires, verily the heavens and the earth and whosoever is therein had been corrupted. Nay, We have brought them their Reminder, but from their Reminder they now turn away.

explanation.bs: „Kad bi se istina povodila za njihovim strastima, nebesa i Zemlja bi propali, i svi koji su u njima“ – množina, mnoge strasti.
explanation.en: “And if the Truth had followed their desires, verily the heavens and the earth and whosoever is therein had been corrupted” — the plural, many desires.

quranTranslation.text: Beautified for mankind is love of the joys (that come) from women and offspring; and stored-up heaps of gold and silver, and horses branded (with their mark), and cattle and land. That is comfort of the life of the world. Allah! With Him is a more excellent abode.

explanation.bs: „Ljudima je uljepšana ljubav prema požudama: prema ženama, sinovima i hrpama nagomilanog zlata i srebra…“ – ar-Rāġib: može obuhvatiti obje vrste.
explanation.en: “Beautified for mankind is love of the joys [passions] (that come) from women and offspring; and stored-up heaps of gold and silver…” — ar-Rāġib: it may cover both kinds.

quranTranslation.text: Now there hath succeeded them a later generation whom have ruined worship and have followed lusts. But they will meet deception.

explanation.bs: „Zatim su poslije njih došli nasljednici koji su namaz upropastili i za požudama se poveli“ – ar-Rāġib: lažne požude.
explanation.en: “Now there hath succeeded them a later generation whom have ruined worship and have followed lusts” — ar-Rāġib: the false kind.

quranTranslation.text: Allah verily hath shown grace to the believers by sending unto them a messenger of their own who reciteth unto them His revelations, and causeth them to grow, and teacheth them the Scripture and wisdom; although before (he came to them) they were in flagrant error.

explanation.bs: „Allah je zaista učinio dobro vjernicima time što im je poslao Poslanika iz njihovih redova …“ – ar-Rāġib navodi ovaj ajet kao minna djelom, kako Njemu priliči.
explanation.en: “Allah verily hath shown grace to the believers by sending unto them a messenger of their own” — ar-Rāġib cites this ayah as minna by deed, as befits Him.

gloss.en: to bestow grace; to reproach with a favour

quranTranslation.text: They make it a favour unto thee (Muhammad) that they have surrendered (unto Him). Say: Deem not your Surrender a favour unto me; but Allah doth confer a favour on you, inasmuch as He hath led you to the Faith, if ye are earnest.

explanation.bs: „Računaju ti kao uslugu to što su prihvatili islam. Reci: ‚Ne računajte mi svoj islam kao uslugu, nego Allah vama čini dobro time što vas je uputio u iman …‘“ – ar-Rāġib: njihova minna je riječima, Allahova djelom.
explanation.en: They count their becoming Muslim as a favour done to the Prophet; he is told to answer that it is Allah who has shown them grace by guiding them to faith — ar-Rāġib: their minna is by word, Allah's by deed.

gloss.en: to bestow grace; to reproach with a favour

quranTranslation.text: The path of those whom Thou hast favoured; Not the (path) of those who earn Thine anger nor of those who go astray.

explanation.bs: „Put onih kojima si darovao blagodat, a ne onih na koje se gnjev spustio, niti onih koji su zalutali“ – ar-Rāġib navodi ‚kojima si darovao blagodat‘.
explanation.en: “The path of those whom Thou hast favoured; Not the (path) of those who earn Thine anger nor of those who go astray” — ar-Rāġib cites ‘whom Thou hast favoured’.

quranTranslation.text: And (Solomon) smiled, laughing at her speech, and said: My Lord, arouse me to be thankful for Thy favour wherewith Thou hast favoured me and my parents, and to do good that shall be pleasing unto Thee, and include me in (the number of) Thy righteous slaves.

explanation.bs: „… Gospodaru moj, nadahni me da budem zahvalan na Tvojoj blagodati koju si darovao meni i mojim roditeljima …“ – Sulejman: blagodat koju čovjek prepoznaje i na kojoj zahvaljuje.
explanation.en: “My Lord, arouse me to be thankful for Thy favour wherewith Thou hast favoured me and my parents” — Solomon: a favour one recognises and gives thanks for.

quranTranslation.text: The King of mankind,

explanation.bs: „Kralju ljudi“ – baš ono što ar-Rāġib kaže: malik se veže za ljude; o Allahu, kako Njemu priliči.
explanation.en: “The King of mankind” — just what ar-Rāġib says: malik is tied to people; of Allah, as befits Him.

quranTranslation.text: She said: Lo! kings, when they enter a township, ruin it and make the honour of its people shame. Thus will they do.

explanation.bs: „Rekla je: ‚Kad kraljevi zauzmu neko naselje, opustoše ga, a njegove ugledne stanovnike učine poniženima …‘“ – ar-Rāġib navodi ovaj ajet za vlast koja se stvarno vrši.
explanation.en: “She said: Lo! kings, when they enter a township, ruin it and make the honour of its people shame” — ar-Rāġib cites this ayah for power actually exercised.

quranTranslation.text: Say: O Allah! Owner of Sovereignty! Thou givest sovereignty unto whom Thou wilt, and Thou withdrawest sovereignty from whom Thou wilt. Thou exaltest whom Thou wilt, and Thou abasest whom Thou wilt. In Thy hand is the good. Lo! Thou art Able to do all things.

explanation.bs: „Reci: ‚Allahu, Vlasniče vlasti, Ti vlast ustupaš kome želiš, a vlast uzimaš od koga želiš …‘“ – ar-Rāġib navodi ovaj ajet; kako Njemu priliči.
explanation.en: “Say: O Allah! Owner of Sovereignty! Thou givest sovereignty unto whom Thou wilt, and Thou withdrawest sovereignty from whom Thou wilt” — ar-Rāġib cites this ayah; as befits Him.

quranTranslation.text: Have they not seen how We have created for them of Our handiwork the cattle, so that they are their owners,

explanation.bs: „… stvorili smo im stoku, pa su je oni vlasnici“ – ista riječ o ljudima: posjed, ne vladanje.
explanation.en: “… We have created for them of Our handiwork the cattle, so that they are their owners” — the same word of people: ownership, not rule.

quranTranslation.text: Firmly established in the favour of a Mighty King.

explanation.bs: „… na sjedištu istine, kod Vladara pune moći“ – jedino mjesto ove riječi; o Allahu, kako Njemu priliči.
explanation.en: “Firmly established in the favour of a Mighty King [malīk]” — the one place of this word; of Allah, as befits Him.
